description: **Auto-query injection + code checks (rescoped 2026-10-05):** before dispatching agents, query SmartMemory for callers of X, types used by X and tests covering X, and inject them as a structured context block plus an auto file list in briefs, replacing broad file reads (token saving). Plans must account for every caller of a changed function. Review flags new functions nothing calls (unwired), applies a patch fence (diff outside declared symbols), and runs only the tests that reach changed code.
phase: STRAT-CODEGRAPH: Code Graph Context for Agents
